key_highlights: ASX declines ahead of impending RBA interest rate decision amid persistent inflation and mounting sovereign/household debt.
Westpac posts $6.8B full-year profit while forecasting an 11% property decline as Australian home values fall for a seventh straight month.
Wall Street's $1.4T sell-off increases spillover volatility for Australian equities.
M&A interest emerges in consumer discretionary with Rip Curl owner (KMD Brands) in offshore buyout talks.

sectors.trend: Solid earnings offset by decelerating credit growth and property valuation downgrades.
sectors.implications: Westpac's $6.8B profit confirms strong trailing margins, but rising rate pressures and deteriorating auction clearance weigh on forward book quality.

sectors.trend: Bullion capitulation alongside selective critical minerals and exploration momentum.
sectors.implications: Gold miners face margin pressure while juniors advance drilling in Western Australian manganese and gold prospects.

sectors.trend: Weakening household consumption triggering corporate restructuring and foreign takeover bids.
sectors.implications: Depressed valuations attract opportunistic private capital (e.g., KMD Brands), but broader retail foot-traffic and earnings face headwinds.

sectors.trend: Structural supply constraints pushing forward wholesale electricity tariffs higher as coal generation retires.
sectors.implications: Higher industrial power costs add to headline CPI, benefiting merchant generation exposure while challenging consumer margins.

sectors.trend: Protracted residential market contraction driven by consecutive rate increases.
sectors.implications: Softening clearance rates and asset revaluations present headwinds for residential property developers and diversified trusts.

key_themes: Tightening monetary cycle driving a sharper, protracted economic slowdown
Persistent inflation pressures sustained by public sector spending and power costs
Accelerating residential property market downturn across major capitals
Cross-border M&A opportunism targeting discounted domestic retail assets

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta equities; tilt toward defensive cash-flow generators and short-duration cash equivalents.
Reduce exposure to retail mortgage-heavy banks and residential property developers.
Maintain tactical allocation to conventional energy producers and essential utilities.
Implement index put protection and maintain liquid cash reserves.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on M&A re-rating across undervalued consumer brand leaders
opportunities.rationale: Depressed retail asset multiples attract international corporate acquirers.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate top-tier diversified resources with strong free cash flow on macro pullbacks
opportunities.rationale: Robust balance sheets and low-cost production protect returns despite bullion and industrial metal volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in integrated energy producers capturing elevated generation spreads
opportunities.rationale: Accelerated coal retirements underpin structurally higher wholesale power tariffs.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-multiple retail banking exposures facing credit and margin squeeze
defensive_moves.rationale: Projected double-digit home value drops and rising funding costs threaten credit growth and provisioning.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge downside portfolio risk against benchmark indices ahead of the RBA rate decision
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX risk premia face near-term compression from domestic tightening and Wall Street volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish and volatile over 1–3 months as the market absorbs the upcoming RBA rate hike and downgrades earnings expectations in light of the housing correction.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued over 6–12 months with economic growth decelerating, favouring defensive balance sheets and inflation-hedged infrastructure over consumer-facing cyclicals.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and post-meeting monetary statement
Quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade figures
Australian major bank full-year credit provisioning data
US Federal Reserve monetary trajectory and global risk sentiment
watch_list: CoreLogic capital city home value index & auction clearance rates
Iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) and precious metals spot prices
